kind.network: Check the connection and try again.
kind.forbidden: This account has no access to the section.
kind.notFound: The address may be outdated. Go back to the start page.
kind.conflict: The data was updated while you were looking. Refresh it and try again.
kind.validation: Some fields are filled in incorrectly.
kind.server: Try again in a minute. If that does not help, restart the backend.
kind.unknown: Try again. If the error stays, the browser console has the details.

api.server_unavailable: The backend does not respond. Try again in a minute or restart it.
api.network_unavailable: Check the connection and try again.
api.stand_unavailable: The stand data pack is missing. Build it with the stand-pack command and restart the backend.
api.unknown_category: This category is not in the stand data. Pick one from the list.
api.review_item_not_found: Someone has already handled it. Refresh the queue.
api.review_already_resolved: The value has changed. Check it and repeat the manual edit.
api.invalid_correction: Enter the correct value before saving.
api.model_failure: Try again. If that does not help, choose the Rules method.
api.flow_unavailable: The server has no model or no category search data. Choose the Rules method.
api.invalid_review_evidence: The quote must match a non-empty passage in the card exactly.
api.invalid_review_attribute: Choose an unfilled field from the selected category.
api.model_timeout: Try again. If the timeout repeats, process fewer cards at once.
api.model_unavailable: Try again later or use the Rules method.
api.model_rate_limited: Wait a moment and try again.
api.invalid_model_output: Try again or use the Rules method. No result was accepted.
api.model_capacity: Wait for current requests to finish and try again.
api.model_input_too_large: Shorten the card text or process it with the Rules method.

boundary.title: The page failed to open
boundary.description: Reload the page. If the error repeats, the details are in the browser console.

headline.stand_unavailable: The stand has no data yet
headline.review_item_not_found: The value has left the queue
headline.flow_unavailable: The automatic method is not set up
headline.invalid_model_output: The model returned an invalid response
headline.model_input_too_large: The card exceeds the request limit
